sloka: राज्य भ्रष्टस्य दीनस्य दण्डकान् परिधावतः ।क्व सा दुःख सहाया मे वैदेही तनु मध्यमा ॥३-५८-३॥
transliteration: rājya bhraṣṭasya dīnasya daṇḍakān paridhāvataḥ ।kva sā duḥkha sahāyā me vaidehī tanu madhyamā ॥3-58-3॥

translations.english: Where is that princess from Videha, a sharer of my sorrows, Sita of slender waist who followed this hapless prince disloged from the kingdom into the Dandaka forest?
